analysis.overview: Webhook retry payloads can reuse stale signature metadata.

narratives.title: Retry payload signature metadata is stale
narratives.description: The retry path reuses signature metadata without rebuilding the signed payload.

mitigation.overview: Recompute the signature metadata before enqueueing retry payloads.

verification.overview: The patch covers the retry enqueue path.
verification.review_target_claim: Retry payloads must be signed with current metadata.
patch_findings: Retry signature metadata is rebuilt before enqueue.
verification_findings: No alternate retry enqueue path was found.

cvss.overview: Authenticated users can replay stale webhook retry payloads.
